pages.title: Pull requests and the merge queue
pages.one: Ready pull requests are checked together once and merged on green.

steps.text: Shows each linked pull request's checks live on its ticket and board card
Puts a ready pull request in the queue and finishes
steps.detail: It does not wait for the checks.

steps.text: Takes up to 5 waiting pull requests
Puts them on one group branch on top of develop

branch.then: Split: the likely cause goes last, the rest try again

steps.text: Writes the result on each ticket

branch.then: Its helper wakes with the reason

good: Changes to the checks themselves, and merges you press on a card, run alone.
A pull request that fell behind is checked once on top of develop; nobody updates it by hand.
